title: Textures
note: Every picture the game draws, by world, then category, then type, then name. Built by tools/build-sprites-manifest.cjs from the game's own tables (CITY_SURFACES, CITY_TD_ART and the object and creature tables).

types.label: Park (grass)
types.rule: About 6% of building lots and 3 in 10 of the small lots; corners rounded; trees and rubble on it block; at least one clear cell of sidewalk from any other park and from the shore. Each park lays one grass from its folder over the whole park (Round 430: only one, never mixed), tiled 140px; with no grass art, the base overgrowth.

types.label: Road (asphalt)
types.rule: One texture for every road and alley (Round 430, owner: never mix textures without a border between them); main roads 100px, alleys 50px; crossings exactly as wide as the roads meeting in them. Round 445: street corners, squares and dead ends all turn on one 22px radius; a waypoint room has a plain crossing (no court); only a boss's room has a square. Vehicles park along east-west streets only (they are painted side-on).

types.label: Sea
types.rule: Only along the city edge, never inland. Round 446: its outline is the sea cells blurred into bays and headlands (never a staircase of cells), wobbled by world-wide noise; darker far out, pale teal shallows at the shore, a thin broken line of foam.

types.label: Sidewalk paving
types.rule: All ground that is not road, sea, sand, lot or park. One paving for the whole city, picked by the journey's seed (Round 445; a paving per block clashed across every alley). A strip one cell (25px) wide runs along every main road and round its corners, never built on; alleys have none. The squares where objects stand are sidewalk too: a 100px notch in the street wall.

types.label: Under buildings (lot footing)
types.rule: Under every building, yard and parking lot. Round 445: lots are laid out along the streets. The buildable ground (open ground less the sidewalks) is cut into rectangles, largest first; each into rows 7 to 13 cells deep and lots 5 to 11 cells wide, with one-cell alleys in about a third of the cuts; lots then grow over any sliver beside them. A lot with room for three full storeys is a building; a smaller one is a yard (cargo on the docks, rubble in a blast zone, a parking lot elsewhere) or a pocket park. Never over a street, a sidewalk or the shore.

types.label: Waterfront (beach sand)
types.rule: The beach: from the shoreline to about one cell inland, wider in bays and narrower on points (Round 446); a darker wet band at the water; meets the sea with no border. Nothing is built within 75px of the sea.

types.label: Curb (kerb along every road)
types.rule: A kerb-stone strip along both edges of every road, on the sidewalk side, bent round corners.

types.label: Park edge (kerb round the grass)
types.rule: One strip per park, round its rounded outline, on a solid base.

types.label: Waterfront edge (concrete lip)
types.rule: Round 461 (owner chose it): no strip art; the paving ends in a concrete lip drawn by the painter (GEN.coastLip) at full resolution along the sand, with a soft shadow on the sand. A strip bent round the curving coast broke into slices.

types.label: Building walls (one floor)
types.rule: Floor by floor, each starting and ending on plain wall between windows (CITY_TD_GAPS). Round 445: three floors at least, every storey 42 to 50px on screen (cityLotFloors): a lot too shallow for that is not a building. A building's street side and quarter come from the city's plan, so it looks the same in every room it reaches into; no building has the same wall as the one beside or behind it, where the art allows.

types.label: Destroyed buildings (burnt-out wall, one floor)
types.rule: A ruin's walls, floor by floor between window holes. Round 445: ruins gather in blast zones (the 18% of the city where a smooth noise runs highest): about 6 in 10 buildings there, 1 in 50 elsewhere. A ruin has an ordinary roof and parapet with a large hole in it (props/roof-hole/), no rooftop kit, no shopfront and no signs.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): roofs
types.rule: Every building in this quarter, tiled 160px.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): street floor
types.rule: The street floor of a building in this quarter whose street is to the south.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): walls (one floor)
types.rule: The upper floors of every building in this quarter (chronoDistrict), fitted floor by floor between windows.

types.label: Garden quarter: street floor

types.label: Garden quarter: walls (one floor)

types.label: Homes district: walls (one floor)
types.rule: Every building in the homes quarter: 3 or 4 floors, no shopfront and no signs; fitted floor by floor between windows (CITY_TD_GAPS).

types.label: Market quarter: roofs
types.rule: Round 454: the roofs of this quarter (CITY_ROOF_KIT says what stands on each).

types.label: Market quarter: street floor

types.label: Market quarter: walls (one floor)

types.label: Roofs
types.rule: One per building part, tiled 160px; a raised parapet and a cast shadow; rooftop props (props/) sized per kind, 18px clear of the edge. Round 445: no building has the same roof as the one beside or behind it, where the art allows.

types.label: Shopfronts (street floor)
types.rule: The street floor of a building whose street is to the south, fitted like a wall.

types.label: The mall: roof
types.rule: Round 453: the mall's one roof; only small kit stands on it (CITY_ROOF_KIT).

types.label: The mall: street floor
types.rule: Round 453: the mall's front, facing its walkway and parking: entrances and display windows.

types.label: The mall: walls (one floor)
types.rule: Round 453: the upper floors of the city's one mall (GEN.mall), fitted floor by floor between windows.
